points.label: The promenade from Old Town (a way in and out)
Through the ferry terminal (a way in and out)
The fish market lane (a way in and out)
By boat to the harbour steps (a way in and out)
The quayside: thousands of people, food vans and music. Hannah's fire engine is parked here, and the fireboat is moored at the quay
The fireboat, moored at the quay (its pumps draw straight from the harbour)
Where the first rocket bursts white and falls burning onto the quay: the Ash Widow walks out of the sparks with Hannah in her grip
The fireworks barge: moored out in the harbour. The show is fired from here
The ferry terminal: a glass hall, open late for the festival
The fish market roof: a flat roof where people climb for a better view (the iron stair in the lane)
The promenade: the wide walk from Old Town to the long pier
The harbour steps: stone steps down to the water, where small boats tie up
